description: This file contains PHP functions related to displaying survey questions within the Surveys module of a CRM application. It includes functions to render survey questions in different views (detail or edit), fetch linked survey question beans, and prepare Smarty template variables.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering HTML in the application.

classes.name: SurveyQuestions
classes.description: Data bean representing survey questions, with methods to retrieve linked options and convert to array.

methods.name: survey_questions_display
methods.description: Main function to display survey questions, choosing between edit or detail view based on context and responses.

methods.name: survey_questions_display_detail
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying survey questions in detail view, using Smarty templates.

methods.name: survey_questions_display_edit
methods.description: Generates HTML for editing survey questions, including options for each question.
